settings.name: Glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine, copper(II) complex
settings.description: Used in topical formulas for the appearance of firmer, smoother-looking skin. Naturally cobalt-blue in solution.

settings.name: Alanyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine, copper(II) complex
settings.description: Used in topical formulas for the look of fuller, denser-appearing hair around the scalp and beard.

settings.heading: Two copper-peptide complexes. Two single-purpose serums.
settings.lede: Copper-peptide complexes are tripeptides bound to a copper(II) ion. The deep blue is the complex itself — no dye, no fragrance.

settings.name: GHK-Cu Serum
settings.tag: For the appearance of firmer-looking skin

settings.name: AHK-Cu Serum
settings.tag: For the look of fuller, denser-appearing hair

settings.label: Cleanse
settings.title: Start with clean, dry skin
settings.body: Use your usual gentle cleanser. Pat dry. The serum absorbs best on bare skin.

settings.label: Apply
settings.title: Press in 3 to 5 drops
settings.body: Smooth a thin layer across the face or scalp area. Let the cobalt-blue formula settle for about a minute.

settings.label: Layer
settings.title: Follow with moisturizer or SPF
settings.body: Once dry, continue your usual routine. Use morning or night — consistency matters more than time of day.

settings.heading: Three steps. Once a day.
settings.lede: A simple topical routine designed for the appearance and feel of the skin or scalp.

settings.heading: Every ingredient, on the record.
settings.lede: Short ingredient decks. No fragrance, no dyes, no fillers we cannot defend.

settings.question: Why is the serum blue?
settings.answer: The color is the copper-peptide complex itself. We do not add any pigment or dye. If the formula goes pale, the active has degraded.

settings.question: Is this a drug?
settings.answer: No. These are cosmetic products intended to beautify and promote attractiveness. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

settings.question: Can I use both serums?
settings.answer: Yes. They are formulated to be used in the same routine — GHK-Cu on the face, AHK-Cu on the scalp or beard area. Apply each to clean, dry skin and follow with your usual products.

settings.question: How should I store it?
settings.answer: Keep the bottle closed, away from direct sunlight, at room temperature. Copper-peptide solutions are sensitive to light and to other actives — use the serum on its own layer.
